Hi Nicole,

That is wierd. I just installed Distance 5 beta 5 and R 2.1.1 (the last
version supported) on a vanilla Windows XP machine, and ran the 1st analysis
in the Golftees example, and it worked fine (see below). Let's correspond
about this off the list, and post a solution when we find it.

Please tell me (off the list),

- what version of Windows you're using, and what language (US English, I
guess)
- where Distance is istalled on your machine (c:\program files\distance 5 ?)
- check that there's a file mrds.zip in that directory

Thanks!

- Len

messages.author: 5900eadecec2d82d
messages.subject: Re: MRDS results error message
parts:
Turns out that Nicole had unzipped the mrds.zip file in the Distance program
directory. Leaving it unzipped solved the problem.

As a general rule, don't touch the files in the Distance program directory, or
any of the sub-directories except Sample Projects!

Cheers,

- Len
